# Thor App Manager

> Free and open-source Android app manager to freeze, suspend, debloat, and manage system and user packages via Root, Shizuku, or Dhizuku.

## Project Overview
Thor is an Android application manager built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Material 3 Design. It provides safe system debloating, application freezing/suspending, split APK installation, and signature-verified extension management across multiple privilege backends.

## Core Capabilities
- **Safe System App Debloating & Freezing**: Disables system packages (`pm disable`) or uninstalls for user 0 (`pm uninstall -k --user 0`) preserving user data. Reversible at any time via `pm enable` or `pm install-existing`.
- **Universal Android Debloater (UAD) Integration**: Dynamic safety recommendation chips (Recommended, Advanced, Expert, Unsafe) to prevent system bootloops.
- **Multiple Work Modes**:
  - **Root Support**: Direct su execution via Odin root service.
  - **Shizuku Support**: System privilege execution via wireless debugging / ADB without root.
  - **Dhizuku Support**: Device owner management without continuous ADB re-arming.
- **Redesigned App Installer**: Install base APKs and split archives (`.apkm`, `.apks`, `.xapk`).
- **Extension Manager**: In-app catalog of optional add-ons, each signature-verified and SHA-256 validated before install.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero trackers, zero analytics, zero ads. Declares no network permission except for the optional Extensions catalog and Google Play billing in the store flavor.

## Official Distribution Channels
- **Direct APK (GitHub Releases)**: https://github.com/trinadhthatakula/Thor/releases/latest
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.valhalla.thor
- **IzzyOnDroid (F-Droid Repository)**: https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/index/apk/com.valhalla.thor
